question: compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH base AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed, anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS anc4_pct FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_pct END) AS anc4_pct_2021, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_pct END) AS anc4_pct_2023, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_pct END) AS pct_point_change FROM base

CURRENT QUESTION:
compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered
attempts.response:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    pregnancies_registered,
    anc4_completed,
    anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS anc4_pct
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_pct END) AS anc4_pct_2021,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_pct END) AS anc4_pct_2023,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_pct END) AS pct_point_change
FROM base;
